title: 🌀 Standard Rotation
description: 🔄 Rotates the list right by two positions.

title: ♻️ Rotation Beyond Length
description: 📏 Reduces k using the list length before rotating.

title: 🛑 No Rotation
description: ⏸️ Keeps the list unchanged when no rotation is requested.

title: 🔁 Full-Length Rotation
description: ♻️ Rotating by the list length returns the original list.

title: 🎯 Single-Step Rotation
description: ➡️ Moves the last node to the front.

title: 🔗 Two-Node List
description: 🔄 Swaps the two nodes through a single rotation.

title: 📦 Single Node
description: 🛑 A single-node list remains unchanged regardless of k.

title: 🌱 Empty List
description: 🛑 An empty list cannot be rotated.

title: 🚀 Large Rotation
description: ♻️ A huge rotation count is reduced modulo the list length.

title: 🔀 Middle Rotation
description: 🔄 Moves the last half of the list to the front.
